convert an IN subquery to a semi-join
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows

WITH time_dim AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE time_dim.t_hour = 8
      AND time_dim.t_minute >= 30
), store AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE store.s_store_name = 'ese'
), household_demographics AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE household_demographics.hd_dep_count = 0
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM store
JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
)
ORDER BY count(*)
LIMIT 100
